text:
Cora (Partnerships): kicking off Lumen Slab EAP with SI QuantaOps. NDA countersigned. Need: bench matrix, telemetry floor, SI handoff checklist, lab sloting, marketplace badge + embargo. Keep replies brief.

Arjun (Eng-ML): propose matrix: batches [1,8,32], seqs [128,512,2048], models: rwd-gpt-3b, community-13b-q4. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, sustained tokens/sec, memory/GPU, power draw, and a 250-sample quality sanity. I'll own runs and results.

Bea (Infra): harness staged at gs://redwood-eap/lumen/harness-v1.tar.gz. Need QuantaOps SSH key for bastion (10.77.88.0/24) and datacenter SR. Note: Lumen Slab boards have adaptive thermal stepdown after ~70m; partner says firmware toggle exists for soak tests. Also we'll capture PDU wattage every 15s.

Marta (Legal): partner requested per-minute telemetry exports. We should refuse raw request exports. Draft amendment: allow 1-min aggregated perf counters (no request text, no user ids) and provide daily CSV export as default. I'll upload wording.

Luis (Product): marketplace draft in drive. Partner requests "Lumen-Accelerated" badge and co-branded hero. Marketing likes that; legal may prefer "Lumen-Validated". Also want to feature an A/B result with QuantaOps scheduler if perf uplift is consistent.

QuantaOps-Rep: happy to support scheduler tests and will send firmware image for non-throttle mode. We want 1-min counters for our internal dashboards; can accept read-only dashboard if raw exports are blocked.

Arjun (Eng-ML): run snippet for steady-state we will use (adding to CI ticket):

```bash
# warmup + steady-run
python perf_runner.py --model rwd-gpt-3b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --warmup 400 --iters 1200 --out gs://redwood-eap/lumen/results/run-01.log
```
Bea (Infra): creating JIRA LUMEN-EAP-1 for keys, SR, and lab booking. Tentative slots Tue/Thu next week 08:00-16:00 PT. Keeping Fri available for firmware window. Will also add A/B configs.

Marta (Legal): uploaded NDA amendment: "Allowed telemetry: aggregated perf counters (1-min buckets), GPU temp (avg/max), PDU wattage; prohibited: raw request payloads, user identifiers, traceable UUIDs. Exports: daily aggregated CSV or secure dashboard access only." Review and ack.

ci-bot: perf job queued: lumen-run-22 (owner: Bea). Link: https://ci.redwood/runs/lumen-run-22

Cora (Partnerships): owners recap: Arjun (runs + prompts), Bea (infra + lab), Marta (legal redline + MOU), Luis (marketplace + comms). Timeline: baseline runs +5d, firmware test +7d, legal finalize 48h, marketplace copy freeze in 10d. Target joint announcement ~2 weeks after stable baseline. React with :white_check_mark: to accept tasks.

Arjun (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark: I'll push prompt set (250) to drive and start runs Thu AM.

Bea (Infra): :white_check_mark: booking lab and adding PDU capture.

Marta (Legal): :white_check_mark: will send MOU and logo usage clause.

Luis (Product): :white_check_mark: looping in comms and design for co-brand assets.

QuantaOps-Rep: :thumbsup: will send firmware and scheduler creds.

Cora (Partnerships): thanks all. If partner insists on raw exports, offer read-only secure dashboard + audited access and daily CSV instead. Keeping thread as audit.
